# Credit Sylvanas

> Credit Sylvanas is a free, non-commercial website that shows World of Warcraft Forever auction house prices for the EU and NA (Americas) regions, using the public data files published by TradeSkillMaster. It is a fan project and is not affiliated with TradeSkillMaster, Blizzard Entertainment or Wowhead.

Prices are shown in gold, silver and copper (1 gold = 100 silver = 10,000 copper). Region prices update once a day. Market value is what an item usually sells for right now, based on auction listings over the last couple of weeks. The 60-day average is market value averaged over about 60 days. Sold per day is the average number of units sold per day across the region. Charts and tables cover the last 90 days.

Pricing data from TradeSkillMaster (https://tradeskillmaster.com). The site has no bulk download, export or API, because TradeSkillMaster's terms do not allow republishing their data in bulk.

Each item has its own page at https://credit-sylvanas.app/{region}/items/{itemId}, where region is us, eu, kr or tw and itemId is the World of Warcraft item id.

Last reviewed 2026-11-22.

## Prices

- [EU market](https://credit-sylvanas.app/eu): Most traded items, biggest price moves and hottest items on the EU auction house.
- [NA market](https://credit-sylvanas.app/us): Most traded items, biggest price moves and hottest items on the NA (Americas) auction house.
- [EU items](https://credit-sylvanas.app/eu/items): Search and sort every EU item by market value, sale rate and daily sales.
- [NA items](https://credit-sylvanas.app/us/items): Search and sort every NA item by market value, sale rate and daily sales.
- [EU heatmaps](https://credit-sylvanas.app/eu/heatmap): How EU prices compare with the other regions, and daily price changes for traded items.
- [NA heatmaps](https://credit-sylvanas.app/us/heatmap): How NA prices compare with the other regions, and daily price changes for traded items.

## About

- [Home](https://credit-sylvanas.app/): Pick a region and see its auction house at a glance.
- [About and data log](https://credit-sylvanas.app/about): What each number means, where the data comes from and a log of recent imports.
- [Privacy](https://credit-sylvanas.app/privacy): What the site and its hosting, analytics and tooltip services process, and your rights.
- [Impressum](https://credit-sylvanas.app/impressum): Who runs the site, how to reach them, and trademark and link notes.
